race.comment: HALF LISTENING (13) was an absolute eye-catcher last start at the Sunny Coast when coming from well back and charging up the inside to only miss by a lip. Can't see the 2000m being a query, and down in the weights he will take plenty of holding out late. EASY LOVE (5) made an impressive return at EF last month but hasn't quite been able to go on with in her last two when firm in the market. Rises from the mile straight to 2000m, and that could be exactly what she wants. HOT MAJESTY (6) arrives in winning form and can give another bold sight on speed. SAVISANTA (1) knocked off the hot-pot here two weeks ago and while the distance won't bother him, he does have to lug the weight and a wide draw doesn't make things any easier for Maloney. LA ROSETTA (9) is an improving staying type that really put her rivals to the sword last start. Is another that is drawn wide but she does keep Benny Thompson in the saddle. Not underestimating.
